events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam's Big Day
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! What's your favourite Liam Gallagher moment, from Oasis anthems to his solo swagger?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo single 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates today. What does this iconic song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, with its release to market on November 10, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's 25 years since the original iPod dropped, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets, what's your favourite 007 moment? Shaken, not stirred, of course.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, what's your top John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A double album packed with diverse sounds. What's your standout track?

events.title: 35 years since the death of Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead vocalist of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Today marks 35 years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His incredible talent and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations. What's the track that always gets you?

events.title: 46 years since the death of John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, outside his New York City residence.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His music, his message, his impact on the world endures. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?
